name: page-thumbnails
title: Page Thumbnails
description: Every page of a chapter in a grid, to jump anywhere: a nav of numbered page buttons, each a small 2px case with the page (lazy image, aspect from its width and height, a paper mat in dark mode so scans stay light) and its number on a fine plate. The page on screen (one, or two for a spread) has a 3px frame and its number plate is an ink flat that sweeps in (aria-current=page); pages already read carry a brush check. Hover lift, ink focus ring, pressed offset. In manga order the grid runs right to left. The columns fill the width from a minimum size (three at 375 px). When it opens inside a dialog or a scroll frame, the page being read is scrolled into view. It also takes pages of the page model ({ page: PageData }), drawn small by Page.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/page-thumbnails". It takes the same pages as PageReader and ReaderStrip; put it in a Sheet opened from the reader's toolbar and close the sheet in onSelect.
